notes: Nothing eligible except the generic SumUp spletna trgovina (prevzem v trgovini, 0 € + 2,50 %). No Slovenian food-truck or restaurant online-ordering tool with an own-site price exists that I could find: compare-research-1's 8 searches and today's 2 returned marketplaces (Wolt, Glovo, Bolt Food, ehrana), foreign tools without Slovenian presence (UpMenu /sl 404, Owner.com, Ecwid, Gastronovi, Restimo — the last two seen only in search, no Slovenia shown) and a school project. Restaumatic re-read: Slovenian pages, online ordering, but no pickup wording and no price. DISH has no Slovenia site (METRO not present; dish.co/SI 404 in compare-research-1). Anolla not recorded (rule). Stop rule applied. Storekit (owned by agent 1): its supported-regions doc lists Slovenia (English, EUR payments), but prices are GBP only, so it is recorded and not counted.
